newsitem.title: USA: Philadelphia policeman charged in cabbie's murder.
newsitem.headline: Philadelphia policeman charged in cabbie's murder.

text.p: Philadelphia police said Tuesday that for the second time this week, they have solved a crime by finding a suspect among their own ranks.
Rance Morgan, a three-year veteran of the force, was arrested and taken to police headquarters in handcuffs and charged in a 1992 murder, WTXF-TV said Tuesday night.

Morgan, of Germantown, was charged with the March 1, 1992, beating death of cab driver Kenneth Bellamy. Police spokesmen had no comment other than to say Commissioner Richard Neal would hold a press briefing or release a statement Wednesday.
Police sources told WTXF that Morgan and two friends pursued Bellamy after his cab hit a parked car in Philadelphia. Once they caught up with him, he was beaten and died two weeks later, they said.
Jeff Kolansky, Morgan's attorney, said his client was innocent and "confused about why he is under arrest."
The other two men have also been charged.
It was the second arrest of a uniformed officer in a week.

Carlos Alvarez, 34, was charged Saturday with sexual assault, corrupting a minor and lesser charges. Alvarez was charged while off duty with raping a girl in his apartment Friday morning, after he persuaded her to visit for a photo session. She reported the incident to police immediately after leaving.
